_readme: ONNX Runtime GPU install candidates for Jetson, keyed by the EXACT detected environment (jetpack_family + cuda_major + python_abi + arch). This file ships EMPTY of real candidates on purpose: no wheel URL, filename, or version here has been verified installable/importable on a real Jetson AGX Orin from this development environment (which is x86_64 and has no ARM64 wheel to test). scripts/install_jetson_ort.py REFUSES to guess a URL for an unlisted combination -- it reports 'no candidate configured' and the caller falls back to CPU Safe Mode. To add a real candidate: on the target Jetson device, obtain the correct ARM64 ONNX Runtime GPU wheel for that exact JetPack from an official NVIDIA source (Jetson AI Lab / Jetson Zoo / NVIDIA's JetPack-matched pip index for that L4T release), add an entry below with the fields filled from what you actually installed, and confirm the install with `python3 scripts/verify_jetson_agx_gpu.py` before relying on it here.

candidates.notes: Placeholder. Never filled from a guess -- only from a real successful install on the target device.
